title: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines to introduce new chef-curated menus and premium wine program for international Suites guests
summary: Alaska and Hawaiian are elevating inflight dining with new menus from celebrated chefs, paired with refreshed premium wine selections designed to complement the flavors of each destination-inspired meal.
body_markdown: Boeing 787 Dreamliner Interior Experience Photoshoot Images featuring the Boeing 787 Dreamliner interior.
